fields.name: Batch Reference
fields.description: Stable client/period/currency idempotency reference. Check Xero and reservation ledger before creating or retrying.

fields.name: Billing Evidence
fields.description: Frozen booking/rate manifest and create/send receipts. An ambiguous result must be reconciled before retry; timestamp alone is not an exactly-once guarantee.

fields.name: Automation Key
fields.description: Stable deduplication key set by automations, normally campaignRecordId|alert_type.

fields.name: Open Automation Key
fields.description: Populated only while an automated alert task is still open.

fields.name: Time Since Created
fields.description: Shows the time elapsed since the record was created.

fields.name: Campaign
fields.description: Links these EmailBison settings to the authoritative Campaign record.

fields.name: Content Channel
fields.description: Determines whether n8n routes this record through the Alex Woung or Alex Woung Raw content workflow.

fields.name: Distribution Channels
fields.description: Approved repurposing outputs to generate from the finalized video and its clips.

fields.name: Requested Clip Count
fields.description: Number of short-form clips requested for this content item.

fields.name: Minimum Clip Score
fields.description: Minimum OpusClip virality score required before a clip is imported for distribution. Defaults to 85 in the Content Center.

fields.name: Idea Score
fields.description: AI qualification score from 0 to 100 for scraped content ideas.

fields.name: Idea Source URL
fields.description: Original Reddit post or external source used for the idea.

fields.name: Idea Source Community
fields.description: Source subreddit or community name.

fields.name: Idea Decision
fields.description: Automation decision: Auto Scheduled, Needs Review, or Archived.

fields.name: Idea Qualification Reason
fields.description: Short explanation of why the scraped question was accepted or rejected.

fields.name: Idea Source Key
fields.description: Canonical Reddit post ID. One primary idea per source across channels; duplicate historical rows leave this blank.

fields.name: Previous Thumbnail URL
fields.description: Previous thumbnail preserved when requesting a new version. Existing Frame.io assets remain available.

fields.name: Thumbnail Revision Instructions
fields.description: Requested changes for the latest thumbnail revision; saved only when regeneration is accepted.

fields.name: Thumbnail Revision Request ID
fields.description: Latest revision identifier used to suppress duplicate retries and prevent stale results replacing a newer thumbnail.

fields.name: OpusClip Short Project ID
fields.description: Managed Content OS short-clipping pass identity; separate from existing long-form OpusClip Project ID. Do not manually reset to retry provider jobs.

fields.name: OpusClip Short Source Asset ID
fields.description: Managed Content OS short-clipping pass identity; separate from existing long-form OpusClip Project ID. Do not manually reset to retry provider jobs.

fields.name: OpusClip Short Job State
fields.description: Managed Content OS short-clipping pass identity; separate from existing long-form OpusClip Project ID. Do not manually reset to retry provider jobs.

fields.name: Days to Close
fields.description: Calculates the number of days between Created Date and Deal Closed Date.

fields.name: Closed Month Text
fields.description: Displays the month and year when the deal was closed, formatted as 'MMMM YYYY'.

fields.name: Clip Transcript
fields.description: Verbatim text returned by OpusClip for this generated clip; used to create channel-specific distribution drafts.

fields.name: Editorial Review Notes
fields.description: Review recommendations, evidence and remaining QA. Not approval and not publishing copy.

fields.name: Review Intent JSON
fields.description: Authenticated Content Center review request. Not an approval/status. Backend must validate under shared lock; public webhook cannot supply intent.

fields.name: Review Snapshot JSON
fields.description: Display-only mirror of backend verified final media snapshot. Never authoritative for approval or scheduling; backend ledger governs.

fields.name: Review Receipt JSON
fields.description: Display-only review result receipt. Never authoritative for replay, approval or scheduling; backend ledger governs.

fields.name: Last Blacklist Check ID
fields.description: EmailGuard blacklist-check UUID used for follow-up polling and troubleshooting.

fields.name: Requested Mailbox Count
fields.description: Usually 2 inboxes per domain.

fields.name: Mailbox 1 Prefix
fields.description: Text before @ for the first mailbox.

fields.name: Mailbox 2 Prefix
fields.description: Text before @ for the second mailbox.

fields.name: Mailbox Source
fields.description: Source used to provision the mailboxes on this domain.

fields.name: Selected Domains
fields.description: One approved available domain per line.

fields.name: Batch Size
fields.description: Default 15; allowed 10-20 domains per checkout.

fields.name: Minutes Between Batches
fields.description: Default 3 minutes between paid checkout batches.

fields.name: Batch Order IDs
fields.description: One CheapInboxes order ID per completed batch; used for duplicate protection.

fields.name: Forwarding URL
fields.description: Optional transparent destination on the client's real website.

fields.name: Content Channel
fields.description: Copied from the parent content record so n8n can route this distribution item to the correct Alex Woung channel.

fields.name: Automation Queue Receipt
fields.description: Managed verification receipt for externally queued browser automation, not native platform scheduling or publication. JSON v1 binds automation/context/record/content/date to enabled verification with max 24-hour validity. UI read-only; does not approve or trigger posting. Missing/expired/disabled receipts fail closed.

fields.name: Enabled Reply Types
fields.description: Reply categories the agent is allowed to draft or handle for this workspace.

fields.name: Always Require Human Review
fields.description: These reply categories always remain in human review even when the workspace is on autopilot.

fields.name: Calendar Provider
fields.description: Calendar service used when the agent needs to propose or book a meeting.

fields.name: Calendar Connection Status
fields.description: Operational status of the workspace calendar connection.

fields.name: Reply Handoff Mode
fields.description: Controls when client ownership begins. Disabled keeps Dulcy handling replies; After First Agent Reply hands off after one Dulcy reply; All Replies hands off immediately.

fields.name: Calendar Connection Request JSON
fields.description: Authenticated board request for a single workspace and account; contains no provider credentials.

fields.name: Calendar Connection Result JSON
fields.description: Result correlated to the request ID; one-time connection link expires after 24 hours.

fields.name: Calendar Connection Snapshot JSON
fields.description: Read-only server connection status and timestamp; no access or refresh tokens.

fields.name: Story Sequences Per Week
fields.description: Target number of Instagram story sequences to prepare each week.

fields.name: Story Frames Per Sequence
fields.description: Default number of frames in each story sequence.

fields.name: Snapshot Key
fields.description: Unique workspace/date key used for idempotent updates.

fields.name: Avg First Response to Booked Hours
Positive Meetings Booked
fields.description: Confirmed bookings among positive conversations in this cohort; unknown remains blank.

fields.name: Unknown Responder Replies
fields.description: Confirmed sent replies whose AI or human ownership is not verified.

fields.name: Measured Meeting Touches
fields.description: Conversations with complete message history and verified booking evidence used in average touch count.

fields.name: Measured Booking Response Times
fields.description: Confirmed meetings with an observed first response before booking used in the response-to-booking average.

fields.name: Attachment Summary
fields.description: An AI generated summary of the Attachments field. Upload files to Attachments to generate a summary.

fields.name: Attachment Summary
fields.description: An AI generated summary of the Attachments field. Upload files to Attachments to generate a summary.

fields.name: Coverage ID
fields.description: Immutable client + canonical booking + charge/adjustment identity. Enforce uniqueness in the billing worker before reserving.

fields.name: Booking ID
fields.description: Verified calendar booking identity; not assumed to be the existing AI Call ID.

fields.name: Reschedule Group
fields.description: Stable original-booking identity shared by all reschedules, billed once.

fields.name: Adjustment Amount
fields.description: Signed monetary adjustment; include original coverage/invoice reference in evidence. Do not infer unused credits from void invoices.

fields.name: Evidence
fields.description: Eligibility basis, agreed terms version, original coverage reference for credits, and historical invoice evidence. Missing feedback is uncertainty, not an automatic exclusion.

fields.name: Signed PDF
fields.description: Completed PDF uploaded privately from the signing service.

fields.name: Signing Record
fields.description: Signed evidence chain and public verification key; no access tokens.

fields.name: Activity Log
fields.description: Read-only operational mirror of signing events. The authoritative signed evidence remains in the signing service.

fields.name: Attachment Note
fields.description: Explains when a completed file must be downloaded securely from the manager instead of attached to Airtable.

fields.name: Client Legal Name
fields.description: Confirmed contracting legal entity. Leave blank and flag if not confirmed.

fields.name: Prepared Terms Snapshot
fields.description: System-written snapshot of the details and PDF used for a signing draft. A change requires a new draft and review; do not edit manually.

fields.name: Agreement Type
fields.description: Choose the approved source agreement. PPC/PPL remains review-only until its source billing deadline conflict is resolved.

fields.name: LinkedIn
fields.description: Include this service in the reviewed agreement and frozen onboarding selection. Cold email is included in the approved base service.

fields.name: AI / Cold Caller
fields.description: Include this service in the reviewed agreement and frozen onboarding selection. Cold email is included in the approved base service.

fields.name: Direct Mail
fields.description: Include this service in the reviewed agreement and frozen onboarding selection. Cold email is included in the approved base service.

fields.name: Qualified Call Fee
fields.description: PPC/PPL confirmed USD pricing. Leave unconfirmed values blank; never enter a guessed amount.

fields.name: Monthly Tech Fee
fields.description: PPC/PPL confirmed USD pricing. Leave unconfirmed values blank; never enter a guessed amount.

fields.name: Initial Fee
fields.description: PPC/PPL confirmed USD pricing. Leave unconfirmed values blank; never enter a guessed amount.

fields.name: Close Lead ID
fields.description: Existing Close lead ID (lead_...). Optional when a Client Intake is already linked. Used to create the onboarding intake; never creates a Close lead or opportunity.

fields.name: Close Opportunity ID
fields.description: Existing Close opportunity ID (oppo_...). Specify when the lead has multiple active opportunities; otherwise the workflow requires one unambiguous active opportunity.

fields.name: Preparation Requested
fields.description: Internal draft-only trigger for the new preparation form. Never sends an invitation.
